27. In determining seriousness the court should consider the following table. The court should
determine which level of seriousness – A, B, or C – the case before it falls into, having regard
to these features, or to any other features which the court considers relevant to its assessment
of seriousness.

SERIOUSNESS

LEVEL A LEVEL B LEVEL C

driving which falls not far
short of dangerous driving

29. The maximum sentence provided by law for the offence of causing death by careless, or
inconsiderate, driving is 5 years’ imprisonment or detention.
